modules.module_title: Conduct quality checks on the commodities

pcs.pc_description: collect representative samples of the relevant commodities to conduct quality checks
follow standardized sampling procedures to ensure unbiased and accurate representation
label, record, and prepare samples for laboratory testing
maintain sample integrity to avoid contamination or deterioration
conduct the relevant quality checks on the commodity samples both physical quality assessment and lab testing and determine the quality based on applicable parameters
dispose of waste samples as per environmental and laboratory protocols
grade commodities as per FSSAI, AGMARK, BIS, or Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) norms
check that the relevant quality processes are followed by the supplier in the handling and transportation of commodities, e.g. using a refrigerated vehicle for perishable commodities during transit
examine the quality of commodities during unloading at the warehouse to ensure no quality- related issues with the commodities
identify the unsuitable commodities and ensure their removal from the stock
coordinate with the concerned supplier(s) to resolve the quality-related issues identified with the commodities
carry out appropriate documentation concerning the commodity quality inspection and the relevant action taken
